department: Department of Chemical Engineering and Materials Science

deadline.value: Apply by December 4 for full consideration; applications are still reviewed through December 15.
deadline.quote: The CEMS application deadline is December 4.

gre_general.quote: GRE is not required and if a score is submitted, we will not review out of fairness to other applicants.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by a faculty committee, not by an individual supervisor.
supervisor.quote: Graduate admissions decisions are made exclusively by a committee of faculty from the Department of Chemical Engineering and Materials Science.

funding.value: All full-time PhD students in good standing receive an assistantship or fellowship with tuition waiver and health insurance.
funding.quote: All full-time doctoral students in good academic standing receive complete financial support in the form of an assistantship or fellowship.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: One PhD admission page covers Chemical Engineering or Materials Science.
